verdict.rationale: a-Shell is documented as a Unix-like terminal on iOS that bundles the ios_system command set and runs commands locally in the app. grep is shown in documented usage, and file operations such as creating directories, moving, compressing and uncompressing files are described. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming ls, cat, tar and curl as included commands, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run local UNIX commands like ls, grep, cat, tar, and curl directly in the app

citations.quote: The goal in this project is to provide a simple Unix-like terminal on iOS.
It uses ios_system for command interpretation, and includes all commands from the ios_system ecosystem
`help -l | grep command` will tell you if your favorite command is already installed.
Create directories, move files, compress them, uncompress them, edit them
